messages:
maria-ng: Heads-up — planning a canary rollout for the serving runtime patch tonight 21:00 UTC. Small cohorts, geo-aware. Need owners for smoke checks + rollback ready. :eyes:
kevin-h: I can own the us-east cohort smoke. what %s and ramp cadence are we doing?
samir: I'll take eu smoke. pls post quick checklist and rollback command.
maria-ng: plan: 3 cohorts — us-east (10% -> 30% -> 60%), us-west (10% -> 40%), eu-central (10% -> 50%). each step is 20m with 10m observation windows. rollback if error rate > 0.7% or latency p95 regression > 150ms vs baseline.
ash: (typo) — sorry, meant ashley: i'll own us-west. sending smoke checklist now.
ash: reacted with :thumbsup:
ashley: smoke checklist (quick):
- verify 200/200 ping responses to /health on the new pods
- run 50 synthetic requests through the canary model route (chat + embeddings)
- check tokenization edge cases from recent failing prompts
- confirm logs contain no KV-cache OOM traces
- confirm rollout metrics in console show expected token/sec increase

kevin-h: posting the quick rollout config we'll apply to orchestrator: 
```
rollout: butterfly_cohort
steps:
  - cohort: us-east
    percent: 10
    duration: 20m
  - cohort: us-west
    percent: 10
    duration: 20m
  - cohort: eu-central
    percent: 10
    duration: 20m
  - ramp_us-east: percent: 30
    duration: 20m
  - ramp_us-west: percent: 40
    duration: 20m
  - ramp_eu-central: percent: 50
    duration: 20m
auto_rollback_thresholds:
  error_rate: 0.007
  latency_p95_ms: +150
```

maria-ng: thanks. ops-oncall — can you stand by for a potential rollback?
ops-oncall: yes, i'll be reachable. please ping me right at the start of any window.
kevin-h: quick note: we'll route a small spike of internal traffic through the canary first (10% internal traffic flag) for 5m to validate tracing and perf. then open to production cohorts.
jun: once the first two 20m windows look good i'll validate store-level metrics (cache hit-rate, token cost delta). i'll report in this thread.
samir: eu smoke cmd (ops): `kubectl -n model-serving rollout status deployment/model-serving-canary` and `kubectl exec -it -n model-serving <pod> -- curl -sS localhost:8080/health` — i'll run those at start of cohort.
maria-ng: perfect. owners: kevin (us-east), ashley (us-west), samir (eu). jun will verify infra metrics. ops-oncall standby.
kevin-h: noted. i'll also watch the canary logs for KV-cache warnings and tokenization errors.
ash: reacted with :rocket:
maria-ng: last ask — if any alert fires, DO NOT advance. call rollback and tag this thread. rollback command is `orchestrator rollback --release model-2026-05-02-v2` (ops-oncall confirm).
ops-oncall: confirmed rollback command and will execute on approval.
maria-ng: thanks everyone. starting prep 20:40 UTC for a 21:00 start. i'll post once traffic gates are flipped. :thumbsup:
